name: Identixweb Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2017, Identixweb Limited is a technology company specializing in Shopify app development and custom web solutions.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
The company specializes in SaaS-based digital product solutions, primarily focusing on Shopify application development. Its key strengths include Shopify expertise, customer-centric solutions, and a global presence.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 67.0 to 105 days.
